case: The finish prepared in the first segment; two results posted after the report, one of them resolved; another seat objected to the report; the operator stopped the run and resumed it; the report was published again and the coordinator prepared the finish in the continuation.
design: docs/adr/0015 "Preparing the finish": after a resume, the first prepare (or done) opens the new segment at the next generation, with its own boundary, and carries by name every post still late when the run was resumed; no boundary forgives an unresolved post.
docs/adr/0015 decision 10: an objection holds until it is resolved, whatever the report's version; a resolved post stays resolved.
docs/adr/0013 decision 12: a resume appends to the same registers and rewrites nothing.
